Graded on completion and effort; lowest 2 dropped

Small-group science communication project; peer-assessed; no drops

grading.drop: Drops: lowest 1 pre-lecture, lowest 2 lecture activities, lowest 1 lab, lowest 1 homework, lowest 1 of 3 exams. Project has no drops.

exams.name: Exam 1
exams.note: In a lecture period; not cumulative

exams.name: Exam 2
exams.note: In a lecture period; not cumulative

exams.name: Exam 3
exams.note: Cumulative; optional if you are happy with exams 1 and 2

ENVS 420.finalExam: The third exam is cumulative and given in the assigned finals-week slot; you may skip it if satisfied with exams 1 and 2.

materials.item: No formal textbook; readings posted on the course webpage

ENVS 420.attendance: Attendance means broad participation (meetings, discussions, assignments, forums, webpage activity). Tell the instructor beforehand about missed work. Lab attendance is taken.
ENVS 420.lateWork: 10% off per day past the due date unless an extension was granted before the due date or an excused emergency applies.
other: Generative AI needs permission before submitting work and any AI-made parts must be labeled.
Posting course content to study-help sites violates the Student Code.
Pre-lecture and homework work is dropped for the lowest score only once each.
